parameters.name: Application
parameters.description:
The name of the software that you want to uninstall.

You can call the [ListInstalledSoftware](~~188591~~) operation to query the software that is installed in the cluster.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc uninstall-software --cluster-id ehpc-hz-jeJki60000 --application ABYSS_2.1.5 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
